title: Lifting etale inverse-image sections from an inverse limit
statement: Let $I$ be nonempty and directed, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a system of qcqs schemes with affine transition morphisms, and $c$ a limit cone [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Choose $i_0\in I$, a sheaf of sets $G$ on $D(i_0)$, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object $W_0$ over $D(i_0)$. For every section $t$ of the inverse image of $G$ on $W_0\times_{D(i_0)}c.pt$, there are an object $j$ of $\mathrm{Over}(i_0^{\mathrm{op}})$ and a section $s$ of the inverse image at that stage such that the canonical cone section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] maps $s$ to $t$.

source.place: Theorem Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), degree zero for sheaves of sets; proof via Tags 0EYL, 04HR, 09YN and the finite affine-cover reduction for qcqs schemes

proof.text: Prove naturality of etaleSetSectionComparison with respect to the etale object by expanding its adjunction-unit, unit-compatible composition, equality transport and pullback-pasting factors. Naturality of these four factors and functoriality of restriction give the restriction square.

Supply the affine lifting hypothesis using etaleSetSectionLift_affine, then apply etaleSetSectionLift_local_family to obtain a common-stage finite compatible family and its covering and local image equations.

Regard each local section as a map from PUnit. The stage sheaf condition existsUnique_amalgamation_ofArrows glues the compatible family to y. Naturality of the comparison and the local image equations show that the comparison of y has the same restrictions as t on the covering at the limit. The limit sheaf condition hom_ext_ofArrows identifies these two maps from PUnit. Evaluation at its unique element gives the claimed stage section and equality, including the empty-cover case.

proof_origin.place: Original two-step route retained through affine lifting and a finite compatible local family; naturality and final gluing proved in Lean by C2
